title: Codex integration identifies itself via OpenTelemetry service.name on the root span
answers: How do I tell which agent produced a Codex trace?
Where is the Codex root span service name set?
body:
The Codex root span is created in libs/typescript/integrations/codex/src/tracing.ts:processNotify with attributes `{ model, 'service.name': 'codex' }`.
The agent identity is carried by this span attribute, not by a trace tag, so new agent integrations should set service.name the same way on their root span.
libs/typescript/integrations/codex/tests/tracing.test.ts asserts `getRootSpan().attributes['service.name']` equals 'codex'; keep that assertion when changing root span creation.
The documented behavior is in libs/typescript/integrations/codex/README.md and docs/docs/genai/tracing/integrations/listing/codex.mdx.
applies: Applies to the Codex TypeScript integration root span; other integrations are only implied to follow the same convention.
says: Traces in the monitoring dashboard should identify the coding agent that produced them.
Cannot filter or distinguish Codex activity traces from other assistant sessions in the viewer.
Display the agent service identity on top-level spans within the tracing interface.
